name: student-support-navigator
description: Student Support Navigator - Track 1: Student Triage & Routing Prototype

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "server,client,open" -c "blue,teal,magenta" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" "npm run open:server"
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
